7: “…He has to hold…” In (Sefer) Kavanot it is written that before the blessing he shall hold the two handles (of the scroll) and during the blessing he shall take away his left hand to give strength to his right hand. And in these manuscripts (?), it is written that during the blessing he shall hold with his two hands the writing sheets of the Torah through the wrapping (around the scroll) and after the blessing he shall remove the left (hand).
